description: Implementation of CustomerOptionService, providing methods for managing customer options including listing, saving, deleting, and retrieval by code within a merchant store context.

classes.name: CustomerOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing CustomerOption entities, extending generic service functions and implementing custom logic for customer options management within a store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption objects for a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerOption and associated customer attributes and option sets.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by its code within a merchant store.
